actual_scope: Exhaustive check that no facet of the mode zonotope Z=sum[-1,1]m_i carries a one-dimensional depth obstruction to R=1 (#6312/#6320/#6333): all 422,224 facet hyperplanes in 41 orbits under Aut(H8) x sign flips have gap-free off-facet subset sums; completeness by exact ridge-adjacency closure. Also: all 21,589 rank-6 flats of the representatives (every ridge up to symmetry) have hole-free 2-D projected zonogons, so no ridge shadow obstructs R=1.

bottleneck_link: Side result on the exact mode-preserving rounding contract; no supplier invoice changes.
